_comment2: Slamtec RPLIDAR A1M8 datasheet: range 0.15-12 m, angular res <=1 deg, scan 5.5 Hz nominal (5-10 Hz), sample rate up to 8 kHz, 905 nm. This is the RTX-lidar sensor profile referenced by omni:sensor:modelName='RPLIDAR_A1M8' on the robot's OmniLidar prim; it (NOT the omni:sensor:Core:* prim attributes) is what actually sets /scan min/max range, which drives the Nav2 costmap.
name: RPLIDAR A1M8
_comment0: SLAMTEC RPLIDAR A1M8, standard mode ~5.5 Hz, ~1 deg (360 rays/rev)

profile._comment1: 5.5 Hz * 360 rays = 1980 -> ~1 deg angular resolution (A1M8 spec <=1 deg)
